spec.description:
Autex Bespoke Print Quietspace is a premium, high-absorption acoustic panel
engineered to deliver maximum acoustic performance alongside completely bespoke
visual graphics. Built on a 25mm thick, dual-density Quietspace Panel base with
a high-density compressed face and cushioned absorber backing, custom designs
and murals are digitally UV printed directly onto the surface without
compromising sound absorption. Achieving an exceptional NRC of 0.85 and Group 1
fire classification, it is the ultimate acoustic art solution for reverberant
interior spaces.
features:
Bespoke digital UV printing on
high-performance acoustic substrate
Absorbs a minimum of 85% of sound energy (NRC 0.85)
Printed surface has zero adverse effect on acoustic absorption

Group 1 fire
rating to AS ISO 9705 - 2003

Engineered for broadband sound absorption across
high and low frequencies

Certified Carbon Neutral product with third-party
verified EPD

Lightweight, easy to handle and precision trim on
site

technical.value: 1200 mm x 2400 mm; 1200 mm x 2700 mm; custom lengths up to 3600 mm

Resists 120-joule impact when adhered to 10mm
plasterboard

range.size_or_rating: 1200 mm x 2400 mm x 25 mm, NRC 0.85
1200 mm x up to 3600 mm x 25 mm, NRC 0.85

spec.fire:
AS
ISO 9705 - 2003 and AS 5637.1: Group 1; ISO 9705: Group 1-S; BS EN 13501-1:2018:
B - s2, d2
spec.compliance:
NCC BCA Specification 7 (C1.10) Group 1 fire
compliance; AS ISO 9705:2003; ISO 354; ISO 9001 and ISO 14001
spec.sustainability:
Certified Carbon Neutral; contains minimum 58% recycled PET;
Red List Free (Declare); low VOC; 100% recyclable
install:
Carry panels
vertically upright with two people wearing clean gloves to prevent marks
Ensure substrate is clean, dust-free, and sealed if porous

Verify image
layout and numbering across panel sequence prior to application

Acclimatise
panels in the installation space for at least 24 hours

Trim edges squarely
from the face using a sharp knife and metal straight edge on the offcut

Apply
recommended construction adhesive or contact adhesive evenly to the panel back

Mount panel with high-density printed face outward and softer backing against
substrate

Apply uniform pressure with a clean roller across the face to
activate adhesive bond
selection_checklist:
Verify artwork resolution
meets Autex minimum print specifications (300 DPI vector/raster)

Confirm
total wall/ceiling area and number of sequential panel drops

Confirm acoustic
target requires premium broadband absorption (NRC 0.85)

Check clearances
around light switches, GPOs, and service penetrations

Determine edge
treatment (butt-joined or Autex Type C aluminium profile trims)
accessories:
Autex Edging Solutions Type C (24/25mm anodised aluminium
trim)

Clean installation gloves and
pressure roller
limitations:
Printed face can show scuffing if
subjected to repetitive heavy friction

Do not bend or crease panels as this
causes permanent fracturing of the high-density face

Indoor use only; avoid
direct water saturation

problem_keywords: severe room echo needing decorative fix
loud open plan office with plain walls
use_cases:
controlling reverberation in video
conferencing rooms and presentation suites with custom branded murals

installing custom photographic art panels in recording studios and home cinemas
for broadband absorption

treating large open-plan dining rooms with
high-absorption art panels to reduce diner chatter

reducing harsh flutter
echoes in school music rooms and auditoriums
not_for:
heavy physical
contact areas without barrier rails

high
humidity pool enclosures with direct splash exposure
retrieval.rag_summary:
Autex
Bespoke Print Quietspace merges the class-leading sound absorption of 25mm
dual-density Quietspace Panel with custom digital UV printing. With an
engineered core that absorbs at least 85% of sound energy (NRC 0.85),
high-resolution images, corporate logos, and vibrant graphics are printed
directly onto the compressed face without impeding acoustic performance.
Offering Group 1 fire safety, low VOC emissions, and carbon-neutral credentials,
it serves as a high-performance acoustic broadband absorber masquerading as
bespoke interior art.
